mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assistant_agent_finding ( agent_task_id, step_id, finding_type, severity, target_type, target_id, title, description, evidence_json, suggestion, status, resolved_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{agentTaskId}, #{stepId}, #{findingType}, #{severity}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{evidenceJson}, #{suggestion}, #{status}, #{resolvedTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE step_id = VALUES(step_id), severity = VALUES(severity), title = VALUES(title), description = VALUES(description), evidence_json = VALUES(evidence_json), suggestion = VALUES(suggestion), resolved_time = IF(status = 'RESOLVED', NULL, resolved_time), status = IF(status = 'RESOLVED', 'OPEN', status), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, agent_task_id, step_id, finding_type, severity, target_type, target_id, title, description, evidence_json, suggestion, status, resolved_time, create_time, update_time FROM assistant_agent_finding WHERE agent_task_id = #{agentTaskId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
